scope: Role, ARIA values, value text (formatNumber), ratio, label wiring and authored parts of the web component in happy-dom, the React renderer in react-dom/server (node:test), their markup parity and the compound parts. Rendered lengths are covered by the browser geometry check; visual quality and screen-reader output are not certified.

checks.covers: role=meter, aria-value*, value text by formatNumber (default percent, format JSON, locale, value-text), clamping, --ui-ratio, label wiring, authored parts; the resolver
SSR markup against the web component, compound parts against the preset, Meter.Value children function, render and className functions

limitations: Geometry review (manual, 2026-11-02): track height, radius, fill = ratio × width, the 1.5u row gap, the 2u label | value gap, control font and line height checked in apps/studio/geometry-check.html at every size × B 0 and 1; growth: a long label ellipsizes before the value (minmax(0, 1fr) | auto), the meter keeps a 24u minimum width and fills its container; RTL: the grid mirrors (label at the inline start, value at the end) and the fill grows from the inline start; focus: not focusable; light and dark screenshots of the Tracks family (ladder 3, 4, 6 and the theme unit).
React styling parity is checked in the browser: apps/studio/react-check.html compares the React Meter with ui-meter at five sizes, and Meter.Root parts with the preset ("fails": []).
The source list is the direct sources, not every transitive dependency.
